description:
Visually impaired chefs Alex Teoh and Erna Zakaria are working towards the opening of a one-of-its-kind cafe by the partially blind. But differences lead to a departure that stuns the team, 3 weeks ahead of the launch. As they learn, teamwork is a key ingredient in running an F&B business.

In this episode the Kunyah Cafe crew and founder Aaron Yeoh host two dinners to thank their supporters. 

Watch Ep 1: We're Chefs, We're Partly Blind & We're Opening A Cafe https://youtu.be/Mc-Eg2Ehv2g
Ep 3: I Hire A Chef With Cerebral Palsy, 3 Days Before Opening https://youtu.be/40ixbtJvP98

05:16 Erna's decision to quit
07:25 Differences and clashes
09:49 'Speak English not Hokkien please'
11:13 Who Erna will miss most
11:56 Erna's tempeh saves the day
13:43 Aaron reflects on Erna
14:23 Episode 3 teaser

About the series:
"Our Blind Kitchen" follows the story of chef Alex, cafe founder Aaron and their team as they navigate the challenges and opportunities of opening a cafe run by people with disabilities - Kunyah Cafe, at the Singapore Management University in downtown.
